estimands.hypothesis: Models will retrieve individually relevant hops but lose answer correctness or conclusion support when the final answer requires evidence composition.
estimands.target_population: Large-corpus grounded research QA tasks drawn from the registered Hugging Face source datasets and transformed into the specified hard-grounding category.
estimands.eligible_items: Reviewed gold items in category "multi-hop synthesis" with valid evidence contracts and no unresolved generation defects.
estimands.eligible_systems: Systems with complete predictions under the submission contract on the same reviewed item set.
estimands.primary_contrast: multi-hop synthesis vs native single-row or first-evidence baselines
estimands.estimator: Mean paired system-level metric difference, reported with task bootstrap confidence intervals and category descriptive intervals.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Paired task bootstrap for current pilot diagnostics; reviewed release reports category intervals and paired system deltas with alpha=0.05.
estimands.minimum_sample: 30 double-reviewed items in this category and at least two eligible model baselines.
estimands.missing_data_policy: Exclude items without valid merged reviews from confirmatory estimates; report missing review rows and blocked item counts separately.
estimands.multiplicity_policy: Treat category hypotheses as pre-registered families; report all category estimates and avoid winner-take-all claims when intervals overlap.
estimands.evidence_contract: 3/3 pilot contracts present; 3 trap/control pilot items.
